title: Analyzing Character Representation in Media Content using Multimodal Foundation Model: Effectiveness and Trust

bias_targets.methodology: Detecting faces in long-form media (films), extracting CLIP embeddings, and classifying perceived gender using a logistic regression model. This pipeline quantifies gender representation (e.g., on-screen appearances of female vs. male characters). The study also evaluates the AI model's own predictive bias (e.g., under-detection rates) across different gender categories.

Detecting faces in video frames, extracting CLIP embeddings, and classifying perceived age into distinct brackets using a logistic regression model. This is used to quantify the representation of specific age groups in media (specifically focusing on characters over 50). The study additionally measures the AI model's predictive bias across these age brackets.
